name: Shibaura Mechatronics Corporation
summary: Shibaura Mechatronics Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells semiconductor manufacturing, flat panel displays manufacturing, vacuum, and health-related equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Fine Mechatronics, Mechatronics Systems, Distribution Equipment Systems, and Real Estate Leasing. The company offers cleaning, etching, ashing, semiconductor inspection, and bonding equipment; slice etching, developing, stripping, and panel spin cleaning equipment, as well as IC/COF bonder for flat panel display; sputtering, deposition, and precision parts manufacturing equipment; automatic ticket vending …
